anesthesia_history.description: Prior anesthesia experience and family history

prior_anesthesia.description: Whether patient has had anesthesia before (from q3)

prior_anesthesia_issues.description: Any problems experienced during prior anesthesia, or 'None' if none reported (from q3b). Use 'N/A' if no prior anesthesia.

family_reaction.description: Whether any family member has had an adverse reaction to anesthesia (from q4)

family_reaction_type.description: Type of family adverse reaction, e.g. malignant hyperthermia (from q4b). Use 'N/A' if no family history.

difficult_airway.description: Whether patient has been told they have a difficult airway (from q5)

sleep_apnea.description: Sleep apnea status and CPAP use, if any (from q6)

dental.description: Dental status — loose teeth, dentures, implants, or 'None' (from q7)

allergies_and_medications.description: Allergies and all medications the patient takes

allergies.description: List of known allergies with reactions if provided. Use 'None' if no allergies (from q8, q8b).

prescription_medications.description: List of prescription medications with doses if provided. Use 'None' if none (from q9, q9b).

blood_thinners.description: Blood thinner use including name and dose if provided. Use 'None' if none (from q10).

supplements.description: Non-prescription medications, supplements, or herbal remedies. Use 'None' if none (from q11, q11b).

cardiac_history.description: Heart conditions, chest pain, heart surgery, or stents. Use 'None' if none (from q12).

respiratory_history.description: Asthma, COPD, or other breathing problems. Use 'None' if none (from q13).

exertional_dyspnea.description: Whether patient gets short of breath walking on flat ground or climbing stairs (from q14)

acid_reflux.description: Acid reflux or heartburn status and any medication taken for it (from q15).

recent_health_changes.description: Recent infections, fever, or major health changes in the last few weeks. Use 'None' if none (from q16).

smoking_status.description: Smoking history: never, former, current_light (<1 pack/day), current_heavy (≥1 pack/day), or unknown (from q17, q17b)

smoking_details.description: Duration and amount of smoking if reported. Use 'N/A' if non-smoker (from q17b).

alcohol.description: Weekly alcohol consumption, verbatim if possible (from q18).

recreational_drugs.description: Recreational or illicit drug use with frequency if reported. Use 'None' if none (from q19, q19b).

psychological.description: Patient's emotional state and additional concerns

anxiety_level.description: Patient's expressed emotional state regarding the procedure (from q20).

additional_history.description: Any additional health or surgical history the patient mentioned. Use 'None' if none (from q21).

additional_questions.description: Any additional questions or concerns the patient raised. Use 'None' if none (from q22).

red_flags.description: Critical medical concerns requiring anesthesiologist attention

severity.description: Urgency: low=note for review, medium=needs discussion, high=requires attention, critical=surgery may need postponement

details.description: Explanation of the concern and relevant patient information

asa_classification.description: ASA Physical Status: ASA-I=healthy, ASA-II=mild systemic disease, ASA-III=severe systemic disease, ASA-IV=severe disease threatening life, ASA-V=moribund, not_assessed=insufficient information

notes.description: Brief clinical summary of the patient's health condition and important findings for the anesthesiologist.
